notes.zh: 待核对的收款可以一键全部标为已核对（先确认一次，建议先看一眼 M-Pesa 余额）。
notes.en: Payments to check can now be marked as checked all at once (it asks first; take a quick look at your M-Pesa balance).
notes.sw: Malipo yanayosubiri kukaguliwa sasa yanaweza kuwekwa yote kuwa yamekaguliwa kwa mara moja (inauliza kwanza; angalia salio lako la M-Pesa).
